subject: Extract all frame from a nc file using cpptraj

messages.author: Dulal Mondal
messages.body:
Dear Experts,
How can I extract all frames from a nc file using cpptraj.
Thanking You
With Regards,
Dulal Mondal

messages.author: Carlos Simmerling
messages.body:
depends on the format that you want. for pdb, use this in the trajout:
multi Each frame will be written to a separate file with the frame #
appended to <filename>.
see the cpptraj manual for more details.
